title: discovery/aws: panic on EC2 instances with nil Placement
body:
### What did you do?
Ran EC2 service discovery against an AWS account containing instances where
the DescribeInstances API response has a nil `Placement` field (similar to
the recently-fixed nil-field cases for MSK #19184, ElastiCache, ECS custom
task groups, and Lightsail).

### What did you expect to see?
The instance's optional fields are omitted from the label set, matching the
guard pattern used for every other optional field in this function
(e.g. `if instance.Endpoint != nil { ... }` in discovery/aws/rds.go).

### What did you see instead?
`discovery/aws/ec2.go`'s `refresh()` dereferences `inst.Placement.AvailabilityZone`
and `inst.ImageId` with no nil guard:

    labels[ec2LabelAMI] = model.LabelValue(*inst.ImageId)
    labels[ec2LabelAZ] = model.LabelValue(*inst.Placement.AvailabilityZone)
    azID, ok := d.azToAZID[*inst.Placement.AvailabilityZone]

If `Placement` (or `ImageId`) is nil, this panics. There is no `recover()`
anywhere in `discovery/` or `discovery/aws/`, so this crashes the entire
Prometheus process — same severity described in the MSK fix (#19184).

### System information
Code inspection against `main` (commit 5542b00b9d5933e29d7b597705c718b764bcc1cb).

Suggested fix, mirroring the guard style already in this file and in msk.go:

    if inst.Placement != nil && inst.Placement.AvailabilityZone != nil {
        labels[ec2LabelAZ] = model.LabelValue(*inst.Placement.AvailabilityZone)
        azID, ok := d.azToAZID[*inst.Placement.AvailabilityZone]
        ...
    }
    if inst.ImageId != nil {
        labels[ec2LabelAMI] = model.LabelValue(*inst.ImageId)
    }
